evals.name: boss-email
evals.prompt: can u make this sound less like chatgpt wrote it? sending it to my boss sarah in like 10 min. file is inputs/slop_email.txt
evals.expected_output: Short, direct email with the $45,000 ask and Oct 14 launch intact, no AI tells, specific ask, placeholders for unknown specifics instead of invented ones.
assertions: Fact Lock passes vs original (no lost/invented numbers)
Email ends with a concrete ask (contains a question to Sarah)

evals.name: linkedin-in-my-voice
evals.prompt: rewrite my linkedin announcement (inputs/slop_linkedin.txt) so it sounds like me and not like a robot. here's two things i actually wrote myself so you get my style: inputs/voice_sample_1.txt and inputs/voice_sample_2.txt
evals.expected_output: LinkedIn post matching the user's casual lowercase voice, keeps Northwind, Head of Growth, Contoso, 40,000 -> 1.2M, 6 years; no staircase, no drumroll.
assertions: Keeps job title Head of Growth (any case)
Voice match >= 80% against the user's voiceprint
No emoji, no staircase of one-line paragraphs

evals.name: cover-letter-from-scratch
evals.prompt: write me a cover letter for a junior data analyst role at Spotify. I have a stats degree from UC Davis and did a 6 month internship at Wells Fargo where I built a churn dashboard in Tableau that the retention team used every week. please dont make it sound AI generated, recruiters can tell
evals.expected_output: 200-300 word cover letter, concrete, no 'passionate', no 'I am writing to express', no invented metrics.
assertions: No cover-letter cliches (passionate, I am writing to express, fast-paced...)
No invented metrics (only numbers the user gave)
Mentions UC Davis, Wells Fargo, Tableau, retention team

evals.name: roast-paragraph
evals.prompt: be honest, does this paragraph sound AI written? its for my blog intro. inputs/roast.txt
evals.expected_output: A clear verdict (yes), the specific tells quoted, and an offer or example of a fix.
assertions: Gives a clear verdict that it reads as AI
Quotes at least 5 specific tells from the paragraph
